questionEn: What fact is the correct conclusion based on the topic “Substance and its properties”?
questionUz: “Modda va uning xossalari” mavzusiga asoslangan to‘g‘ri xulosa qaysi fakt?
explanationEn: Knife, nails - bodies; their composition is iron substance.
explanationUz: Pichoq, mixlar - tanalar; ularning tarkibi temir moddasidir.
